"""Sanity checks for ConditionalI18nExtension."""
import pytest

from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2.exceptions import TemplateAssertionError, TemplateSyntaxError
from jinja2.ext import ConditionalI18nExtension, conditional_i18n, i18n
from jinja2 import pass_context

languages = {
    "de": {
        "item": "Element",
        "items": "Elemente",
        "%(num)s item": "%(num)s Element",
        "%(num)s items": "%(num)s Elemente",
    }
}


@pass_context
def gettext(context, string):
    language = context.get("LANGUAGE", "en")
    return languages.get(language, {}).get(string, string)


@pass_context
def ngettext(context, s, p, n):
    language = context.get("LANGUAGE", "en")
    src = p if n != 1 else s
    return languages.get(language, {}).get(src, src)


def make_env(**kw):
    env = Environment(extensions=[i18n, conditional_i18n], **kw)
    env.globals.update(gettext=gettext, ngettext=ngettext)
    return env


env = make_env()


def t(src, **ctx):
    return env.from_string(src).render(**ctx)


# 1. basic: condition true -> translated
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n %}item{% fallback %}ITEM{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "Element"
# 2. condition false -> fallback
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n %}item{% fallback %}ITEM{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=False,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "ITEM"
print("1-2 basic ok")

# 3. comma and space separated headers
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n, num %}{{ num }} item{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=2,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "2 Elemente"
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}{{ num }} item{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=2,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "2 Elemente"
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}{{ num }} item{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=False,
    num=2,
) == "F2"
print("3 commas ok")

# 4. missing fallback
for src in (
    "{% ctrans x %}item{% endctrans %}",
    "{% ctrans x %}item{% pluralize %}items{% endctrans %}",
):
    try:
        env.from_string(src)
    except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
        assert "expected 'fallback' block" in str(e), str(e)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"no error for {src!r}")
print("4 missing fallback ok")

# 5. unclosed
for src in (
    "{% ctrans x %}item",
    "{% ctrans x %}item{% fallback %}F",
    "{% ctrans x %}item{% pluralize %}items{% fallback %}F",
    "{% ctrans x %}item{% pluralize %}items",
):
    try:
        env.from_string(src)
    except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
        assert "unclosed conditional translation block" in str(e), str(e)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"no error for {src!r}")
print("5 unclosed ok")

# 6. duplicate variable
try:
    env.from_string("{% ctrans x num num %}{{ num }}{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}")
except TemplateAssertionError as e:
    assert "defined twice" in str(e), str(e)
else:
    raise AssertionError("no error for duplicate var")
print("6 duplicate var ok")

# 7. trimmed applies to every block incl. fallback
assert t(
    "{%- ctrans use_i18n trimmed %}  a\n  b  {% fallback %}  c\n  d  {% endctrans -%}",
    use_i18n=True,
) == "a b"
assert t(
    "{%- ctrans use_i18n trimmed %}  a\n  b  {% fallback %}  c\n  d  {% endctrans -%}",
    use_i18n=False,
) == "c d"
assert t(
    "{%- ctrans use_i18n notrimmed %}  a\n  b  {% fallback %}  c\n  d  {% endctrans -%}",
    use_i18n=False,
) == "  c\n  d  "
print("7 trimmed ok")

# 8. trimmed policy
env_trimmed = make_env()
env_trimmed.policies["ext.i18n.trimmed"] = True
assert (
    env_trimmed.from_string(
        "{%- ctrans use_i18n %}  a\n  b  {% fallback %}  c\n  d  {% endctrans -%}"
    )
    .render(use_i18n=False)
    == "c d"
)
assert (
    env.from_string(
        "{%- ctrans use_i18n %}  a\n  b  {% fallback %}  c\n  d  {% endctrans -%}"
    )
    .render(use_i18n=False)
    == "  a\n  b  "
)
print("8 trimmed policy ok")

# 9. pluralize
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}{{ num }} item{% pluralize num %}"
    "{{ num }} items{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=1,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "1 Element"
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}{{ num }} item{% pluralize num %}"
    "{{ num }} items{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=5,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "5 Elemente"
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}{{ num }} item{% pluralize num %}"
    "{{ num }} items{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=False,
    num=5,
) == "F5"
# implicit plural var from first referenced name
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n %}{{ num }} item{% pluralize %}"
    "{{ num }} items{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=5,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "5 Elemente"
print("9 pluralize ok")

# 10. newstyle gettext
env2 = make_env()
env2.install_gettext_callables(gettext, ngettext, newstyle=True)
assert (
    env2.from_string(
        "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}%(num)s item{% fallback %}F%(num)s{% endctrans %}"
    )
    .render(use_i18n=True, num=2, LANGUAGE="de")
    == "2 Elemente"
)
assert (
    env2.from_string(
        "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}%(num)s item{% fallback %}F%(num)s{% endctrans %}"
    )
    .render(use_i18n=False, num=2)
    == "F2"
)
print("10 newstyle ok")

# 11. autoescape
env3 = Environment(
    autoescape=True, extensions=[i18n, conditional_i18n]
)
env3.globals.update(gettext=gettext, ngettext=ngettext)
out = env3.from_string(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n name %}{{ name }}{% fallback %}F{{ name }}{% endctrans %}"
).render(use_i18n=True, name="<x>")
print("11a autoescape true branch:", out)
out = env3.from_string(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n name %}{{ name }}{% fallback %}F{{ name }}{% endctrans %}"
).render(use_i18n=False, name="<x>")
print("11b autoescape fallback:", out)

# 12. alias and tags
assert conditional_i18n is ConditionalI18nExtension
assert ConditionalI18nExtension.tags == {"ctrans"}
import jinja2.ext as extmod

assert extmod.conditional_i18n is ConditionalI18nExtension
print("12 alias ok")

# 13. string by string id (identifier)
print("13 identifier:", ConditionalI18nExtension.identifier)

# 14. explicit variable assignment in header
assert t(
    '{% ctrans use_i18n num=5 %}{{ num }} item{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}',
    use_i18n=True,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "5 Elemente"
assert t(
    '{% ctrans use_i18n num=5 %}{{ num }} item{% fallback %}F{{ num }}{% endctrans %}',
    use_i18n=False,
) == "F5"
print("14 explicit vars ok")

# 15. complex condition expression
assert t(
    "{% ctrans num > 1 and use_i18n %}{{ num }} items{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=5,
    LANGUAGE="de",
) == "5 items"
assert t(
    "{% ctrans num > 1 and use_i18n %}{{ num }} items{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=True,
    num=1,
) == "F"
print("15 complex condition ok")

# 16. no variables at all in fallback, literal percent handling
assert t(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n %}100%%{% fallback %}F 100%%{% endctrans %}",
    use_i18n=False,
) == "F 100%"
print("16 percent ok")

print("ALL OK")

from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2 import pass_context
from jinja2.exceptions import TemplateAssertionError, TemplateSyntaxError
from jinja2.ext import i18n, conditional_i18n

def make_env(**kw):
    env = Environment(extensions=[i18n, conditional_i18n], **kw)
    return env

@pass_context
def gettext(context, string):
    return string

@pass_context
def ngettext(context, s, p, n):
    return s if n == 1 else p

env = make_env()
env.globals.update(gettext=gettext, ngettext=ngettext)

# A. no condition at all -> syntax error from expression parser
try:
    env.from_string("{% ctrans %}x{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}")
    print("A: NO ERROR (bad)")
except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
    print("A ok:", e)

# B. newstyle num kwarg skip (num_called_num + have_plural)
env2 = make_env()
env2.install_gettext_callables(gettext, ngettext, newstyle=True)
t = env2.from_string(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n num %}{{ num }} apple{% pluralize %}"
    "{{ num }} apples{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}"
)
print("B1:", t.render(use_i18n=True, num=1))
print("B2:", t.render(use_i18n=True, num=5))

# C. call expression header var (evaluated once)
calls = []
def get_count():
    calls.append(1)
    return 3

t = env.from_string(
    "{% ctrans use_i18n count=get_count() %}{{ count }} apple{% pluralize %}"
    "{{ count }} apples{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}"
)
print("C:", t.render(use_i18n=True, get_count=get_count), "calls:", len(calls))

# D. unknown pluralize variable
try:
    env.from_string("{% ctrans use_i18n %}{{ count }} a{% pluralize other %}b{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}")
    print("D: NO ERROR (bad)")
except TemplateAssertionError as e:
    print("D ok:", e)

# E. fallback-only implicit variable
t = env.from_string("{% ctrans use_i18n %}plain{% fallback %}F{{ only_in_fallback }}{% endctrans %}")
print("E1:", t.render(use_i18n=False, only_in_fallback=42))
print("E2:", t.render(use_i18n=True))

# F. condition using undefined var -> falsy -> fallback
t = env.from_string("{% ctrans missing_flag %}T{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}")
print("F:", t.render())

# G. trimmed var name like trans
t = env.from_string("{% ctrans use_i18n trimmed='w' %}{{ trimmed }}{% fallback %}F{% endctrans %}")
print("G:", t.render(use_i18n=True))

# H. multiple header vars, mixed commas
t = env.from_string("{% ctrans use_i18n, a=1, b %}{{ a }}-{{ b }}{% fallback %}F{{ a }}-{{ b }}{% endctrans %}")
print("H1:", t.render(use_i18n=True, b=2))
print("H2:", t.render(use_i18n=False, b=2))
EOF
